name: Adagio
verdict: Adagio is a joint venture created in France in 2007 between Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: major partner of FDJ United-Suez since June 2025, on the front and back of the jersey for four years (club communiqué). Both parents are listed companies; their major shareholders were not traced (a state would need roughly 10% of one parent to reach 5% of a 50/50 joint venture).
